    { menu: "法人買賣超(億元)", file: "threemastervalue三大法人買賣超金額自選監控.xlsx" },
    { menu: "法人買賣超(張)", file: "threemasternumber三大法人買賣超張數自選監控.xlsx" },
    { menu: "外資", file: "Foreigner外資自選監控.xlsx" },
    { menu: "投信", file: "Investment投信自選監控.xlsx" },
    { menu: "融資融券", file: "Financingbills融資融券自選監控.xlsx" },
    { menu: "股價乖離與新高", file: "goodrate股價乖離與新高自選監控.xlsx" },
    { menu: "成交量變化", file: "amountchange成交量變化自選監控.xlsx" },
    { menu: "營收", file: "income營收自選監控.xlsx" },
    { menu: "重點財務比率", file: "finance重點財務自選監控.xlsx" },
    { menu: "價值評估", file: "value價值自選監控.xlsx" },
    { menu: "基本資訊", file: "basicinfo基本資訊自選監控.xlsx" },
    { menu: "15秒看籌碼", file: "Chips五燈籌碼自選監控.xlsx" }
]

; ----------------------------------------------------------
; 緊急停止 ( Esc ) 
; ----------------------------------------------------------
$Esc:: 
    ToolTip
    MsgBox, 48, Zen AI 系統, 🛑 腳本已中斷執行 (Esc)! , 1.5
    Reload
return

; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
; 🚀 F9：15 檔全自動無人巡航倒檔 (精準咬合)
; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
F9::
    SoundBeep, 900, 150
    Sleep, 80
    SoundBeep, 900, 150
    Sleep, 80
    SoundBeep, 900, 150

    TrayTip, 🤖 Zen AI 全自動倒檔, 正在啟動 15 檔精確對齊倒檔作業..., 5, 1

    TargetDir := "C:\...看盤"
    if !FileExist(TargetDir)
        FileCreateDir, %TargetDir%

    for index, item in ExportItems
    {
        menuName := item.menu
        fileName := item.file
        ToolTip, ⏳ [%index%/15] 正在處理：【%menuName%】...
        
        CloseExcelSafely()
        CleanExcelAutoRecover()
        Sleep, 300

        TargetFile := TargetDir . "\" . fileName

        if (WinExist("ahk_exe CMoney_Utility.exe") or WinExist("理財寶"))
        {
            WinActivate 
            Sleep, 500

            ; 👉 A. 點擊右上角下拉選單 (1819, 81)
            Click, 1819, 81
            Sleep, 400

            ; 👉 B. 🌟 強制展開下拉清單
            Send, {F4}
            Sleep, 600

            ; 👉 C. 回頂端 (第 1 檔: 籌碼集中度)，依序向下移動
            Send, {Home}
            Sleep, 300
            
            DownSteps := index - 1
            if (DownSteps > 0) {
                Send, {Down %DownSteps%}
                Sleep, 300
            }
            Send, {Enter}

            ; 👉 D. 🌟 充裕等待數據載入 (7.5 秒，確保籌碼欄位完全刷新)
            ToolTip, ⏳ [%index%/15] 【%menuName%】正在自雲端載入數據 (7.5 秒)...
            Sleep, 7500 

            ; 👉 E. 表格中央點擊右鍵
            Click, Right, 960, 350
            Sleep, 1000 

            ; 👉 F. 選擇匯出 Excel (向下 7 次按 Enter)
            Send, {Down 7}
            Sleep, 400
            Send, {Enter}

            ; 👉 G. 等待另存新檔視窗 (最多等 15 秒)
            WinWait, ahk_class #32770, , 15
            if ErrorLevel {
                ToolTip, ⚠️ 【%menuName%】未偵測到存檔視窗，跳過...
                continue
            }
            
            WinActivate, ahk_class #32770
            Sleep, 600
            ControlFocus, Edit1, ahk_class #32770
            Send, ^a{Delete}
            Sleep, 300
            
            Clipboard := TargetFile
            ClipWait, 1
            Send, ^v 
            Sleep, 600
            Send, {Enter}
            
            ; 👉 H. 處理覆蓋確認框
            Sleep, 1200
            if (WinExist("確認另存新檔") or WinExist("ahk_class #32770", "取代")) {
                WinActivate
                Send, {Left}{Enter}
            }

            ; 👉 I. 等待 Excel 彈出並優雅關閉
            WinWait, ahk_exe EXCEL.EXE, , 25
            if !ErrorLevel {
                Sleep, 2000
                CloseExcelSafely()
            }
            
            Sleep, 1000
        }
    }

    ; 15 檔全部完成長嗶 2 聲
    SoundBeep, 1200, 300
    Sleep, 100
    SoundBeep, 1200, 300
    ToolTip, ✅ 15 檔真實數據全部匯出完畢！正在啟動 Python 自動灌庫...

    ; 自動呼叫 Python 灌庫
    RunWait, python C:\test_c\test_import_to_old1.py, C:\test_c, Hide

    ToolTip, 🏆 恭喜長官！15 檔真實籌碼數據已全數成功灌入 SQL 資料庫！
    Sleep, 5000
    ToolTip
return

; =========================================================================
; 🛡️ 工具函式：正常安全關閉 Excel
; =========================================================================
CloseExcelSafely() {
    try {
        xl := ComObjActive("Excel.Application")
        xl.DisplayAlerts := false
        xl.Quit()
        Sleep, 500
    } catch {
        WinClose, ahk_exe EXCEL.EXE
        Sleep, 500
    }
    if WinExist("ahk_exe EXCEL.EXE") {
        WinKill, ahk_exe EXCEL.EXE
    }
}

CleanExcelAutoRecover() {
    AutoRecoverDir := A_AppData . "\Microsoft\Excel"
    if InStr(FileExist(AutoRecoverDir), "D") {
        FileDelete, %AutoRecoverDir%\*.*
    }
    UnsavedDir := A_LocalAppData . "\Microsoft\Office\UnsavedFiles"
    if InStr(FileExist(UnsavedDir), "D") {
        FileDelete, %UnsavedDir%\*.*
    }
}

; =========================================================================
; 🛡️ 工具函式：正常安全關閉 Excel (長官原版完美保留)
; =========================================================================
CloseExcelSafely() {
    try {
        xl := ComObjActive("Excel.Application")
        xl.DisplayAlerts := false
        xl.Quit()
        Sleep, 500
    } catch {
        WinClose, ahk_exe EXCEL.EXE
        Sleep, 500
    }
    if WinExist("ahk_exe EXCEL.EXE") {
        WinKill, ahk_exe EXCEL.EXE
    }
}

CleanExcelAutoRecover() {
    AutoRecoverDir := A_AppData . "\Microsoft\Excel"
    if InStr(FileExist(AutoRecoverDir), "D") {
        FileDelete, %AutoRecoverDir%\*.*
    }
    UnsavedDir := A_LocalAppData . "\Microsoft\Office\UnsavedFiles"
    if InStr(FileExist(UnsavedDir), "D") {
        FileDelete, %UnsavedDir%\*.*
    }
}

WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(代號)) = '2330';

-- ============================================================================
-- 👑 驗收第三關：【15 表合體大橫表 (Master View)】
-- 一列展開 2330 在 15 個不同維度的核心指標！
-- ============================================================================
SELECT 
    -- 1. 基本資訊
    B.代號, B.名稱, B.日期, B.成交價, B.漲幅, B.總量, B.開盤價,
    -- 2. 核心籌碼 (Chips)
    C.[看籌碼15秒], C.[籌碼集中度20日], C.[主力買賣超合計20日],
    -- 3. 五燈集中度 (Chips5)
    C5.[集中度1日], C5.[集中度5日], C5.[集中度20日], C5.[集中度60日],
    -- 4. 主力券商分點 (Mainbrokerage)
    MB.[買超1券商] AS [主力Top1分點], MB.[Top1券商買超比重], MB.[連買],
    -- 5. 大戶內部人 (insiderbiger)
    IB.[內部人持股], IB.[內部人月增減], IB.[大戶持股], IB.[大戶週增減],
    -- 6. 外資 (Foreigner)
    FR.[持股比率] AS [外資持股%], FR.[持股成本] AS [外資成本],
    -- 7. 融資融券 (Financingbills)
    FI.[融資成本推估], FI.[融資維持率], FI.[券資比],
    -- 8. 股價乖離 (goodrate)
    GR.[歷史高價], GR.[乖離年線], GR.[乖離季線],
    -- 9. 價值估值 (value)
    V.[本益比], V.[現金殖利率]
FROM basicinfo B
LEFT JOIN Chips C ON LTRIM(RTRIM(C.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號))
LEFT JOIN Chips5 C5 ON LTRIM(RTRIM(C5.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號))
LEFT JOIN Mainbrokerage MB ON LTRIM(RTRIM(MB.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號))
LEFT JOIN insiderbiger IB ON LTRIM(RTRIM(IB.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號))
LEFT JOIN Foreigner FR ON LTRIM(RTRIM(FR.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號))
LEFT JOIN Financingbills FI ON LTRIM(RTRIM(FI.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號))
LEFT JOIN goodrate GR ON LTRIM(RTRIM(GR.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號))
LEFT JOIN value V ON LTRIM(RTRIM(V.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號))
WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號)) = '2330';
GO

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室】理財寶 15 檔 Excel ➔ stockchangedateold1 灌庫特工 V1.4
升級重點：
  1. 目標目錄指向：C:\\...看盤自動
  2. 兼容將錯就錯的「融卷」與「卷商」檔名
  3. 實裝「雙向前後倒置 (20日XXX ➔ XXX20日) ✕ 括號去除」智能欄位匹配引擎
  4. 寫入目標庫：stockchangedateold1
================================================================================
"""
import os
import glob
import time
import datetime
import re
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATA_DIR = r"C:\...看盤自動" if os.path.exists(r"C:\...看盤自動") else r"C:\...看盤"
DB_CONN = r"DRIVER={ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server};SERVER=localhost;DATABASE=stockchangedateold1;Trusted_Connection=yes;"

FILE_TO_TABLE = {
    "basicinfo": "basicinfo",
    "amountchange": "amountchange",
    "Chips五燈": "Chips5",
    "Chips籌碼": "Chips",
    "finance": "finance",
    "Financingbills": "Financingbills",
    "Foreigner": "Foreigner",
    "goodrate": "goodrate",
    "income": "income",
    "insiderbiger": "insiderbiger",
    "Investment": "investment",
    "Mainbrokerage": "Mainbrokerage",
    "threemasternumber": "threemasternumber",
    "threemastervalue": "threemastervalue",
    "value": "value"
}

def get_db():
    return pyodbc.connect(DB_CONN)

def clean_str(s):
    """去除所有空格、括號、百分比與單位符號"""
    return re.sub(r'[\s\(\)（）%％元億]', '', str(s))

def get_transposed_variants(name):
    """生成正向與前後倒置的變體 (如: 20日籌碼集中度 <-> 籌碼集中度20日, 15秒看籌碼 <-> 看籌碼15秒)"""
    s = clean_str(name)
    variants = {s}
    
    # 模式 A: 數字日/秒在開頭 (如: 20日籌碼集中度 ➔ 籌碼集中度20日)
    m1 = re.match(r'^(\d+[日秒]?)(.*)$', s)
    if m1 and m1.group(2):
        variants.add(m1.group(2) + m1.group(1))

    # 模式 B: 數字日/秒在結尾 (如: 籌碼集中度20日 ➔ 20日籌碼集中度)
    m2 = re.match(r'^(.*?)(\d+[日秒]?)$', s)
    if m2 and m2.group(1):
        variants.add(m2.group(2) + m2.group(1))
        
    return variants

def import_all():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🚀 啟動【理財寶 15 檔 Excel ➔ stockchangedateold1】智能雙向對齊灌庫特工")
    print(f"📁 讀取目錄: {DATA_DIR}")
    print("=" * 70)

    conn = get_db()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.fast_executemany = False

    success_cnt = 0
    total_inserted = 0

    for prefix, table_name in FILE_TO_TABLE.items():
        # 搜尋符合前綴的 Excel (自動包容 融券/融卷、券商/卷商)
        pattern = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"*{prefix}*.xlsx")
        matched_files = glob.glob(pattern)
        if not matched_files:
            # 嘗試模糊副檔
            alt_prefix = prefix.replace("券", "卷") if "券" in prefix else prefix.replace("卷", "券")
            matched_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"*{alt_prefix}*.xlsx"))

        if not matched_files:
            print(f"⚠️ 找不到前綴為 [{prefix}] 的 Excel 檔案，略過。")
            continue

        target_file = matched_files[0]
        fname = os.path.basename(target_file)
        t0 = time.time()

        try:
            df = pd.read_excel(target_file)
            if df.empty:
                print(f"  ⚠️ 【{fname}】為空檔，略過。")
                continue

            # 檔案修改日期
            file_mtime = os.path.getmtime(target_file)
            file_date_int = int(datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(file_mtime).strftime("%Y%m%d"))

            # 取得 SQL 資料表欄位 (排除 Identity 自動編號)
            cur.execute(f"""
                SELECT c.COLUMN_NAME, 
                       COLUMNPROPERTY(OBJECT_ID(c.TABLE_SCHEMA + '.' + c.TABLE_NAME), c.COLUMN_NAME, 'IsIdentity') AS IsIdentity
                FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c
                WHERE c.TABLE_NAME = '{table_name}'
            """)
            cols_info = cur.fetchall()
            sql_cols_list = [r[0] for r in cols_info if r[1] != 1]
            has_date_col = "日期" in sql_cols_list

            # 🌟 核心突破：雙向倒置 ✕ 符號清洗 智能欄位映射
            mapped_columns = {}
            for raw_col in df.columns:
                excel_variants = get_transposed_variants(raw_col)
                matched_sql_col = None

                # 逐一與 SQL 欄位變體比對
                for sql_col in sql_cols_list:
                    sql_variants = get_transposed_variants(sql_col)
                    if excel_variants.intersection(sql_variants):
                        matched_sql_col = sql_col
                        break
                
                # 特殊別名人工兜底
                if not matched_sql_col:
                    raw_c = clean_str(raw_col)
                    if raw_c in ["開盤", "開盤價"]:
                        matched_sql_col = "開盤價" if "開盤價" in sql_cols_list else "開盤"
                    elif "本益比" in raw_c and "近四季" in raw_c and "本益比近四季" in sql_cols_list:
                        matched_sql_col = "本益比近四季"
                    elif "現金殖利率" in raw_c and "現金殖利率" in sql_cols_list:
                        matched_sql_col = "現金殖利率"

                if matched_sql_col and matched_sql_col in sql_cols_list:
                    mapped_columns[raw_col] = matched_sql_col

            if not mapped_columns:
                print(f"  ❌ 【{fname}】無法對齊資料表 [{table_name}] 任何欄位！")
                continue

            insert_df = df[list(mapped_columns.keys())].rename(columns=mapped_columns).copy()

            # 代號強制乾淨字串
            if "代號" in insert_df.columns:
                insert_df["代號"] = insert_df["代號"].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True)

            # 補齊日期
            if has_date_col and "日期" not in insert_df.columns:
                insert_df["日期"] = file_date_int

            # 清空舊資料
            cur.execute(f"TRUNCATE TABLE {table_name}")

            final_cols = list(insert_df.columns)
            cols_str = ", ".join([f"[{c}]" for c in final_cols])
            placeholders = ", ".join(["?"] * len(final_cols))
            insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO {table_name} ({cols_str}) VALUES ({placeholders})"

            # 純淨 Tuple 批量寫入
            records = []
            for row in insert_df.itertuples(index=False, name=None):
                clean_row = []
                for val in row:
                    if pd.isna(val) or val in ["--", "-", " ", "", "N/A", "null", "NaN"]:
                        clean_row.append(None)
                    elif isinstance(val, (np.integer, int)):
                        clean_row.append(int(val))
                    elif isinstance(val, (np.floating, float)):
                        clean_row.append(float(val))
                    else:
                        clean_row.append(str(val).strip())
                records.append(tuple(clean_row))

            cur.executemany(insert_sql, records)
            conn.commit()

            elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
            print(f"  ✅ 成功灌入【{table_name}】: {len(records)} 筆 (對齊 {len(final_cols)} 欄 | 日期: {file_date_int}) ➔ 耗時 {elapsed}s (來源: {fname})")
            success_cnt += 1
            total_inserted += len(records)

        except Exception as ex:
            print(f"  ❌ 匯入【{table_name}】失敗: {ex}")

    conn.close()
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"🏆 【stockchangedateold1】智能全欄位對齊灌庫大功告成！")
    print(f"📊 成功灌入: {success_cnt}/15 個資料表 | 總計寫入: {total_inserted} 筆真實資料")
    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import_all()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室】理財寶 15 檔 Excel ➔ stockchangedateold1 灌庫特工 V1.5
針對長官指示全面對齊：
  1. 正式讀取目錄：C:\\...看盤自動
  2. 將錯就錯相容：融卷、卷商 完美對齊
  3. 精確字典對齊：
     - '1上市 2上櫃' ➔ '上市1上櫃2'
     - '本益比(預估)' ➔ '本益比預估'
     - '本益比(近四季)' ➔ '本益比近四季'
     - '現金殖利率(%)' ➔ '現金殖利率'
     - '買家大於賣家60天' ➔ '買家大於買家60天'
     - 雙向前後倒置 (20日XXX <-> XXX20日)
  4. 寫入目標庫：stockchangedateold1
================================================================================
"""
import os
import glob
import time
import datetime
import re
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# 🎯 正式目錄：C:\...看盤自動
DATA_DIR = r"C:\...看盤自動" if os.path.exists(r"C:\...看盤自動") else r"C:\...看盤"
DB_CONN = r"DRIVER={ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server};SERVER=localhost;DATABASE=stockchangedateold1;Trusted_Connection=yes;"

FILE_TO_TABLE = {
    "basicinfo": "basicinfo",
    "amountchange": "amountchange",
    "Chips五燈": "Chips5",
    "Chips籌碼": "Chips",
    "finance": "finance",
    "Financingbills": "Financingbills",
    "Foreigner": "Foreigner",
    "goodrate": "goodrate",
    "income": "income",
    "insiderbiger": "insiderbiger",
    "Investment": "investment",
    "Mainbrokerage": "Mainbrokerage",
    "threemasternumber": "threemasternumber",
    "threemastervalue": "threemastervalue",
    "value": "value"
}

# 🌟 核心精確字典：將所有命名微差 1:1 強制鎖定
EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING = {
    # basicinfo 表
    "1上市 2上櫃": "上市1上櫃2",
    "1上市2上櫃": "上市1上櫃2",
    "開盤": "開盤價",
    "開盤價": "開盤價",
    "股本(億)": "股本億",
    "市值(億)": "市值億",
    "漲幅%": "漲幅",
    # value 表
    "本益比(預估)": "本益比預估",
    "本益比(近四季)": "本益比近四季",
    "現金殖利率(%)": "現金殖利率",
    "殖利率(%)": "現金殖利率",
    "股價淨值比": "股價淨值比",
    # Mainbrokerage 表
    "買家大於賣家60天": "買家大於買家60天",
    "買家大於賣家(60天)": "買家大於買家60天",
    "買家大於買家60天": "買家大於買家60天",
    # Chips 表
    "15秒看籌碼": "看籌碼15秒",
    "看籌碼15秒": "看籌碼15秒",
}

def get_db():
    return pyodbc.connect(DB_CONN)

def clean_str(s):
    """去除空格、括號、百分比與單位"""
    return re.sub(r'[\s\(\)（）%％元億]', '', str(s))

def get_transposed_variants(name):
    """前後倒置變體產生器 (20日籌碼集中度 <-> 籌碼集中度20日, 5日漲幅 <-> 漲幅5日)"""
    s = clean_str(name)
    variants = {s}
    m1 = re.match(r'^(\d+[日秒]?)(.*)$', s)
    if m1 and m1.group(2):
        variants.add(m1.group(2) + m1.group(1))

    m2 = re.match(r'^(.*?)(\d+[日秒]?)$', s)
    if m2 and m2.group(1):
        variants.add(m2.group(2) + m2.group(1))
    return variants

def import_all():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🚀 啟動【理財寶 15 檔 Excel ➔ stockchangedateold1】全欄位精確對齊特工")
    print(f"📁 讀取目錄: {DATA_DIR}")
    print("=" * 70)

    conn = get_db()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.fast_executemany = False

    success_cnt = 0
    total_inserted = 0

    for prefix, table_name in FILE_TO_TABLE.items():
        # 兼容將錯就錯的 融卷/融券、卷商/券商
        pattern = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"*{prefix}*.xlsx")
        matched_files = glob.glob(pattern)
        if not matched_files:
            alt_prefix = prefix.replace("券", "卷") if "券" in prefix else prefix.replace("卷", "券")
            matched_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"*{alt_prefix}*.xlsx"))

        if not matched_files:
            print(f"⚠️ 找不到前綴為 [{prefix}] 的 Excel 檔案，略過。")
            continue

        # 優先取最新修改的檔案
        matched_files.sort(key=os.path.getmtime, reverse=True)
        target_file = matched_files[0]
        fname = os.path.basename(target_file)
        t0 = time.time()

        try:
            df = pd.read_excel(target_file)
            if df.empty:
                print(f"  ⚠️ 【{fname}】為空檔，略過。")
                continue

            file_mtime = os.path.getmtime(target_file)
            file_date_int = int(datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(file_mtime).strftime("%Y%m%d"))

            # 取得 SQL 資料表欄位清單 (排除 Identity 自動編號)
            cur.execute(f"""
                SELECT c.COLUMN_NAME, 
                       COLUMNPROPERTY(OBJECT_ID(c.TABLE_SCHEMA + '.' + c.TABLE_NAME), c.COLUMN_NAME, 'IsIdentity') AS IsIdentity
                FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c
                WHERE c.TABLE_NAME = '{table_name}'
            """)
            cols_info = cur.fetchall()
            sql_cols_list = [r[0] for r in cols_info if r[1] != 1]
            sql_cols_set = set(sql_cols_list)
            has_date_col = "日期" in sql_cols_set

            mapped_columns = {}
            for raw_col in df.columns:
                raw_str = str(raw_col).strip()
                matched_sql_col = None

                # 1. 優先比對「精確字典」
                if raw_str in EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING:
                    target_name = EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING[raw_str]
                    if target_name in sql_cols_set:
                        matched_sql_col = target_name

                # 2. 次要比對「雙向前後倒置與去符號」
                if not matched_sql_col:
                    excel_variants = get_transposed_variants(raw_str)
                    for sql_col in sql_cols_list:
                        sql_variants = get_transposed_variants(sql_col)
                        if excel_variants.intersection(sql_variants):
                            matched_sql_col = sql_col
                            break

                # 3. 直名完全相同比對
                if not matched_sql_col and raw_str in sql_cols_set:
                    matched_sql_col = raw_str

                if matched_sql_col:
                    mapped_columns[raw_col] = matched_sql_col

            if not mapped_columns:
                print(f"  ❌ 【{fname}】無法對齊資料表 [{table_name}] 任何欄位！")
                continue

            insert_df = df[list(mapped_columns.keys())].rename(columns=mapped_columns).copy()

            # 代號轉乾淨字串
            if "代號" in insert_df.columns:
                insert_df["代號"] = insert_df["代號"].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True)

            # 補齊日期
            if has_date_col and "日期" not in insert_df.columns:
                insert_df["日期"] = file_date_int

            # 清空舊資料
            cur.execute(f"TRUNCATE TABLE {table_name}")

            final_cols = list(insert_df.columns)
            cols_str = ", ".join([f"[{c}]" for c in final_cols])
            placeholders = ", ".join(["?"] * len(final_cols))
            insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO {table_name} ({cols_str}) VALUES ({placeholders})"

            # Tuple 純淨寫入 (無 22003 溢位)
            records = []
            for row in insert_df.itertuples(index=False, name=None):
                clean_row = []
                for val in row:
                    if pd.isna(val) or val in ["--", "-", " ", "", "N/A", "null", "NaN"]:
                        clean_row.append(None)
                    elif isinstance(val, (np.integer, int)):
                        clean_row.append(int(val))
                    elif isinstance(val, (np.floating, float)):
                        clean_row.append(float(val))
                    else:
                        clean_row.append(str(val).strip())
                records.append(tuple(clean_row))

            cur.executemany(insert_sql, records)
            conn.commit()

            elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
            print(f"  ✅ 成功灌入【{table_name}】: {len(records)} 筆 (對齊 {len(final_cols)} 欄 | 日期: {file_date_int}) ➔ 耗時 {elapsed}s (來源: {fname})")
            success_cnt += 1
            total_inserted += len(records)

        except Exception as ex:
            print(f"  ❌ 匯入【{table_name}】失敗: {ex}")

    conn.close()
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"🏆 【stockchangedateold1】全欄位精確對齊灌庫完成！")
    print(f"📊 成功灌入: {success_cnt}/15 個資料表 | 總計寫入: {total_inserted} 筆真實資料")
    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import_all()

import os
import glob
import time
import datetime
import re
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATA_DIR = r"C:\...看盤自動" if os.path.exists(r"C:\...看盤自動") else r"C:\...看盤"
DB_CONN = r"DRIVER={ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server};SERVER=localhost;DATABASE=stockchangedateold1;Trusted_Connection=yes;"

FILE_TO_TABLE = {
    "basicinfo": "basicinfo",

}

# 🌟 核心精確字典：將所有命名微差 1:1 強制鎖定
EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING = {

    "漲幅%": "漲幅",

    "賣家>買家60天": "買家大於買家60天",
    "買家大於賣家60天": "買家大於買家60天",
    "買家大於買家60天": "買家大於買家60天",

    # Chips 表
    "15秒看籌碼": "看籌碼15秒",
    "看籌碼15秒": "看籌碼15秒",
}

def get_db():
    return pyodbc.connect(DB_CONN)

def clean_str(s):
    """去除空格、括號、百分比與單位"""
    return re.sub(r'[\s\(\)（）%％元億]', '', str(s))

def get_transposed_variants(name):
    """前後倒置變體產生器 (20日籌碼集中度 <-> 籌碼集中度20日, 5日漲幅 <-> 漲幅5日)"""
    s = clean_str(name)
    variants = {s}
    m1 = re.match(r'^(\d+[日秒]?)(.*)$', s)
    if m1 and m1.group(2):
        variants.add(m1.group(2) + m1.group(1))

    m2 = re.match(r'^(.*?)(\d+[日秒]?)$', s)
    if m2 and m2.group(1):
        variants.add(m2.group(2) + m2.group(1))
    return variants

            continue

        matched_files.sort(key=os.path.getmtime, reverse=True)
        target_file = matched_files[0]
        fname = os.path.basename(target_file)
        t0 = time.time()

        try:
            df = pd.read_excel(target_file)
            if df.empty:
                print(f"  ⚠️ 【{fname}】為空檔，略過。")
                continue

            file_mtime = os.path.getmtime(target_file)
            file_date_int = int(datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(file_mtime).strftime("%Y%m%d"))

            # 取得 SQL 資料表欄位清單 (排除 Identity 自動編號)
            cur.execute(f"""
                SELECT c.COLUMN_NAME, 
                       COLUMNPROPERTY(OBJECT_ID(c.TABLE_SCHEMA + '.' + c.TABLE_NAME), c.COLUMN_NAME, 'IsIdentity') AS IsIdentity
                FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c
                WHERE c.TABLE_NAME = '{table_name}'
            """)
            cols_info = cur.fetchall()
            sql_cols_list = [r[0] for r in cols_info if r[1] != 1]
            sql_cols_set = set(sql_cols_list)
            has_date_col = "日期" in sql_cols_set

            mapped_columns = {}
            for raw_col in df.columns:
                raw_str = str(raw_col).strip()
                matched_sql_col = None

                # 1. 優先比對「精確字典」
                if raw_str in EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING:
                    target_name = EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING[raw_str]
                    if target_name in sql_cols_set:
                        matched_sql_col = target_name

                # 2. 次要比對「雙向前後倒置與去符號」
                if not matched_sql_col:
                    excel_variants = get_transposed_variants(raw_str)
                    for sql_col in sql_cols_list:
                        sql_variants = get_transposed_variants(sql_col)
                        if excel_variants.intersection(sql_variants):
                            matched_sql_col = sql_col
                            break

                # 3. 直名完全相同比對
                if not matched_sql_col and raw_str in sql_cols_set:
                    matched_sql_col = raw_str

                if matched_sql_col:
                    mapped_columns[raw_col] = matched_sql_col

            if not mapped_columns:
                print(f"  ❌ 【{fname}】無法對齊資料表 [{table_name}] 任何欄位！")
                continue

            insert_df = df[list(mapped_columns.keys())].rename(columns=mapped_columns).copy()

            # 代號強制乾淨字串
            if "代號" in insert_df.columns:
                insert_df["代號"] = insert_df["代號"].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True)

            # 補齊日期
            if has_date_col and "日期" not in insert_df.columns:
                insert_df["日期"] = file_date_int

            # 清空舊資料
            cur.execute(f"TRUNCATE TABLE {table_name}")

            final_cols = list(insert_df.columns)
            cols_str = ", ".join([f"[{c}]" for c in final_cols])
            placeholders = ", ".join(["?"] * len(final_cols))
            insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO {table_name} ({cols_str}) VALUES ({placeholders})"

            # Tuple 純淨寫入 (無 22003 溢位)
            records = []
            for row in insert_df.itertuples(index=False, name=None):
                clean_row = []
                for val in row:
                    if pd.isna(val) or val in ["--", "-", " ", "", "N/A", "null", "NaN"]:
                        clean_row.append(None)
                    elif isinstance(val, (np.integer, int)):
                        clean_row.append(int(val))
                    elif isinstance(val, (np.floating, float)):
                        clean_row.append(float(val))
                    else:
                        clean_row.append(str(val).strip())
                records.append(tuple(clean_row))

            cur.executemany(insert_sql, records)
            conn.commit()

            elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
            print(f"  ✅ 成功灌入【{table_name}】: {len(records)} 筆 (對齊 {len(final_cols)} 欄 | 日期: {file_date_int}) ➔ 耗時 {elapsed}s (來源: {fname})")
            success_cnt += 1
            total_inserted += len(records)

        except Exception as ex:
            print(f"  ❌ 匯入【{table_name}】失敗: {ex}")

    conn.close()
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"🏆 【stockchangedateold1】全欄位精確對齊灌庫完成！")
    print(f"📊 成功灌入: {success_cnt}/15 個資料表 | 總計寫入: {total_inserted} 筆真實資料")
    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室】理財寶 15 檔 Excel ➔ stockchangedateold1 灌庫特工 V1.7
死鎖校準：
  1. 100% 強制優先鎖定長官正式檔：融資融卷、主力卷商 (絕對不讀舊券檔)
  2. 智能包容 Investment (有無「監控」皆能識別)
  3. 讀取目錄鎖定：C:\\...看盤自動
================================================================================
"""
import os
import glob
import time
import datetime
import re
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATA_DIR = r"C:\...看盤自動" if os.path.exists(r"C:\...看盤自動") else r"C:\看盤"
DB_CONN = r"DRIVER={ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server};SERVER=localhost;DATABASE=stockchangedateold1;Trusted_Connection=yes;"

# 🌟 精準對齊：將錯就錯，優先鎖定「融卷」與「卷商」
FILE_TO_TABLE = {
    "basicinfo": "basicinfo",
    "amountchange": "amountchange",
    "Chips五燈": "Chips5",
    "Chips籌碼": "Chips",
    "finance": "finance",
    "Financingbills融資融卷": "Financingbills",  # 強制鎖定「卷」！
    "Foreigner": "Foreigner",
    "goodrate": "goodrate",
    "income": "income",
    "insiderbiger": "insiderbiger",
    "Investment": "investment",                  # 自動包容 Investment
    "Mainbrokerage主力卷商": "Mainbrokerage",    # 強制鎖定「卷」商！
    "threemasternumber": "threemasternumber",
    "threemastervalue": "threemastervalue",
    "value": "value"
}

EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING = {
    # basicinfo
    "1上市 2上櫃": "上市1上櫃2",
    "1上市2上櫃": "上市1上櫃2",
    "開盤": "開盤價",
    "開盤價": "開盤價",
    "股本(億)": "股本億",
    "市值(億)": "市值億",
    "漲幅%": "漲幅",
    # value
    "本益比(預估)": "本益比預估",
    "本益比(近四季)": "本益比近四季",
    "現金殖利率(%)": "現金殖利率",
    "殖利率(%)": "現金殖利率",
    "股價淨值比": "股價淨值比",
    # Mainbrokerage (🌟 買家賣家全包容)
    "賣家>買家(60天)": "買家大於買家60天",
    "賣家>買家60天": "買家大於買家60天",
    "買家大於賣家60天": "買家大於買家60天",
    "買家大於買家60天": "買家大於買家60天",
    "買家集中天數(％)": "買家集中天數",
    "買家集中天數(%)": "買家集中天數",
    # Chips
    "15秒看籌碼": "看籌碼15秒",
    "看籌碼15秒": "看籌碼15秒",
}

def get_db():
    return pyodbc.connect(DB_CONN)

def clean_str(s):
    return re.sub(r'[\s\(\)（）%％元億]', '', str(s))

def get_transposed_variants(name):
    s = clean_str(name)
    variants = {s}
    m1 = re.match(r'^(\d+[日秒]?)(.*)$', s)
    if m1 and m1.group(2):
        variants.add(m1.group(2) + m1.group(1))
    m2 = re.match(r'^(.*?)(\d+[日秒]?)$', s)
    if m2 and m2.group(1):
        variants.add(m2.group(2) + m2.group(1))
    return variants

def import_all():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🚀 啟動【理財寶 15 檔 Excel ➔ stockchangedateold1】V1.7 強制鎖定正式檔")
    print(f"📁 讀取目錄: {DATA_DIR}")
    print("=" * 70)

    conn = get_db()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.fast_executemany = False

    success_cnt = 0
    total_inserted = 0

    for prefix, table_name in FILE_TO_TABLE.items():
        # 1. 優先精準比對 (如 Financingbills融資融卷)
        matched_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"*{prefix}*.xlsx"))
        
        # 2. 保底容錯搜尋
        if not matched_files:
            simple_prefix = prefix.split("融")[0].split("主")[0]
            matched_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"*{simple_prefix}*.xlsx"))

        if not matched_files:
            print(f"⚠️ 找不到對應 [{prefix}] 的 Excel 檔案，略過。")
            continue

        # 🌟 核心防禦：若同時有「券」與「卷」，強制選「卷」！
        juan_files = [f for f in matched_files if "卷" in os.path.basename(f)]
        target_file = juan_files[0] if juan_files else matched_files[0]
        fname = os.path.basename(target_file)
        t0 = time.time()

        try:
            df = pd.read_excel(target_file)
            if df.empty:
                print(f"  ⚠️ 【{fname}】為空檔，略過。")
                continue

            file_mtime = os.path.getmtime(target_file)
            file_date_int = int(datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(file_mtime).strftime("%Y%m%d"))

            cur.execute(f"""
                SELECT c.COLUMN_NAME, 
                       COLUMNPROPERTY(OBJECT_ID(c.TABLE_SCHEMA + '.' + c.TABLE_NAME), c.COLUMN_NAME, 'IsIdentity') AS IsIdentity
                FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c
                WHERE c.TABLE_NAME = '{table_name}'
            """)
            cols_info = cur.fetchall()
            sql_cols_list = [r[0] for r in cols_info if r[1] != 1]
            sql_cols_set = set(sql_cols_list)
            has_date_col = "日期" in sql_cols_set

            mapped_columns = {}
            for raw_col in df.columns:
                raw_str = str(raw_col).strip()
                matched_sql_col = None

                if raw_str in EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING:
                    target_name = EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING[raw_str]
                    if target_name in sql_cols_set:
                        matched_sql_col = target_name

                if not matched_sql_col:
                    excel_variants = get_transposed_variants(raw_str)
                    for sql_col in sql_cols_list:
                        sql_variants = get_transposed_variants(sql_col)
                        if excel_variants.intersection(sql_variants):
                            matched_sql_col = sql_col
                            break

                if not matched_sql_col and raw_str in sql_cols_set:
                    matched_sql_col = raw_str

                if matched_sql_col:
                    mapped_columns[raw_col] = matched_sql_col

            if not mapped_columns:
                print(f"  ❌ 【{fname}】無法對齊資料表 [{table_name}] 任何欄位！")
                continue

            insert_df = df[list(mapped_columns.keys())].rename(columns=mapped_columns).copy()

            if "代號" in insert_df.columns:
                insert_df["代號"] = insert_df["代號"].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True)

            if has_date_col and "日期" not in insert_df.columns:
                insert_df["日期"] = file_date_int

            cur.execute(f"TRUNCATE TABLE {table_name}")

            final_cols = list(insert_df.columns)
            cols_str = ", ".join([f"[{c}]" for c in final_cols])
            placeholders = ", ".join(["?"] * len(final_cols))
            insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO {table_name} ({cols_str}) VALUES ({placeholders})"

            records = []
            for row in insert_df.itertuples(index=False, name=None):
                clean_row = []
                for val in row:
                    if pd.isna(val) or val in ["--", "-", " ", "", "N/A", "null", "NaN"]:
                        clean_row.append(None)
                    elif isinstance(val, (np.integer, int)):
                        clean_row.append(int(val))
                    elif isinstance(val, (np.floating, float)):
                        clean_row.append(float(val))
                    else:
                        clean_row.append(str(val).strip())
                records.append(tuple(clean_row))

            cur.executemany(insert_sql, records)
            conn.commit()

            elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
            print(f"  ✅ 成功灌入【{table_name}】: {len(records)} 筆 (對齊 {len(final_cols)} 欄 | 日期: {file_date_int}) ➔ 來源: {fname}")
            success_cnt += 1
            total_inserted += len(records)

        except Exception as ex:
            print(f"  ❌ 匯入【{table_name}】失敗: {ex}")

    conn.close()
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"🏆 【stockchangedateold1】正式檔灌庫完成！")
    print(f"📊 成功灌入: {success_cnt}/15 個資料表 | 總計寫入: {total_inserted} 筆真實資料")
    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import_all()

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室】理財寶 15 檔 Excel ➔ stockchangedateold1 灌庫特工 V1.8
升級重點：
  1. 霸道自動鎖定：'賣家>買家(60天)' 100% 強制對齊 SQL [買家大於買家60天]
  2. 讀取目錄鎖定：C:\\...看盤自動
  3. 保留所有已驗證成功的欄位映射 (本益比近四季、現金殖利率、上市1上櫃2 等)
================================================================================
"""
import os
import glob
import time
import datetime
import re
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATA_DIR = r"C:\...看盤自動" if os.path.exists(r"C:\...看盤自動") else r"C:\...看盤"
DB_CONN = r"DRIVER={ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server};SERVER=localhost;DATABASE=stockchangedateold1;Trusted_Connection=yes;"

FILE_TO_TABLE = {
    "basicinfo": "basicinfo",
    "amountchange": "amountchange",
    "Chips五燈": "Chips5",
    "Chips籌碼": "Chips",
    "finance": "finance",
    "Financingbills": "Financingbills",
    "Foreigner": "Foreigner",
    "goodrate": "goodrate",
    "income": "income",
    "insiderbiger": "insiderbiger",
    "Investment": "investment",
    "Mainbrokerage": "Mainbrokerage",
    "threemasternumber": "threemasternumber",
    "threemastervalue": "threemastervalue",
    "value": "value"
}

# 🌟 精準字典：1:1 強制映射
EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING = {
    # basicinfo 表
    "1上市 2上櫃": "上市1上櫃2",
    "1上市2上櫃": "上市1上櫃2",
    "開盤": "開盤價",
    "開盤價": "開盤價",
    "股本(億)": "股本億",
    "市值(億)": "市值億",
    "漲幅%": "漲幅",
    # value 表
    "本益比(預估)": "本益比預估",
    "本益比(近四季)": "本益比近四季",
    "現金殖利率(%)": "現金殖利率",
    "殖利率(%)": "現金殖利率",
    "股價淨值比": "股價淨值比",
    # Mainbrokerage 表
    "賣家>買家(60天)": "買家大於買家60天",
    "買家集中天數(％)": "買家集中天數",
    "買家集中天數(%)": "買家集中天數",
    # Chips 表
    "15秒看籌碼": "看籌碼15秒",
    "看籌碼15秒": "看籌碼15秒",
}

def get_db():
    return pyodbc.connect(DB_CONN)

def clean_str(s):
    return re.sub(r'[\s\(\)（）%％元億]', '', str(s))

def get_transposed_variants(name):
    s = clean_str(name)
    variants = {s}
    m1 = re.match(r'^(\d+[日秒]?)(.*)$', s)
    if m1 and m1.group(2):
        variants.add(m1.group(2) + m1.group(1))
    m2 = re.match(r'^(.*?)(\d+[日秒]?)$', s)
    if m2 and m2.group(1):
        variants.add(m2.group(2) + m2.group(1))
    return variants

def import_all():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🚀 啟動【理財寶 15 檔 Excel ➔ stockchangedateold1】V1.8 終極灌庫特工")
    print(f"📁 讀取目錄: {DATA_DIR}")
    print("=" * 70)

    conn = get_db()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.fast_executemany = False

    success_cnt = 0
    total_inserted = 0

    for prefix, table_name in FILE_TO_TABLE.items():
        pattern = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"*{prefix}*.xlsx")
        matched_files = glob.glob(pattern)
        if not matched_files:
            alt_prefix = prefix.replace("券", "卷") if "券" in prefix else prefix.replace("卷", "券")
            matched_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"*{alt_prefix}*.xlsx"))

        if not matched_files:
            print(f"⚠️ 找不到對應 [{prefix}] 的 Excel 檔案，略過。")
            continue

        # 優先取用「卷」的檔案
        juan_files = [f for f in matched_files if "卷" in os.path.basename(f)]
        target_file = juan_files[0] if juan_files else matched_files[0]
        fname = os.path.basename(target_file)
        t0 = time.time()

        try:
            df = pd.read_excel(target_file)
            if df.empty:
                print(f"  ⚠️ 【{fname}】為空檔，略過。")
                continue

            file_mtime = os.path.getmtime(target_file)
            file_date_int = int(datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(file_mtime).strftime("%Y%m%d"))

            cur.execute(f"""
                SELECT c.COLUMN_NAME, 
                       COLUMNPROPERTY(OBJECT_ID(c.TABLE_SCHEMA + '.' + c.TABLE_NAME), c.COLUMN_NAME, 'IsIdentity') AS IsIdentity
                FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c
                WHERE c.TABLE_NAME = '{table_name}'
            """)
            cols_info = cur.fetchall()
            sql_cols_list = [r[0] for r in cols_info if r[1] != 1]
            sql_cols_set = set(sql_cols_list)
            has_date_col = "日期" in sql_cols_set

            # 🌟 核心映射邏輯（加固版）
            mapped_columns = {}
            for raw_col in df.columns:
                raw_str = str(raw_col).strip()
                matched_sql_col = None

                # 1. 🌟 終極霸道鎖定：只要是 Mainbrokerage 且欄位含 60 與 買家/賣家，直接綁定！
                if table_name == "Mainbrokerage" and "60" in raw_str and ("買" in raw_str or "賣" in raw_str):
                    col_60 = next((c for c in sql_cols_list if "60" in c and "買" in c), None)
                    if col_60:
                        matched_sql_col = col_60

                # 2. 優先比對「精確字典」
                if not matched_sql_col and raw_str in EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING:
                    target_name = EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING[raw_str]
                    if target_name in sql_cols_set:
                        matched_sql_col = target_name

                # 3. 雙向前後倒置 (20日XXX <-> XXX20日)
                if not matched_sql_col:
                    excel_variants = get_transposed_variants(raw_str)
                    for sql_col in sql_cols_list:
                        sql_variants = get_transposed_variants(sql_col)
                        if excel_variants.intersection(sql_variants):
                            matched_sql_col = sql_col
                            break

                # 4. 直名完全相同比對
                if not matched_sql_col and raw_str in sql_cols_set:
                    matched_sql_col = raw_str

                if matched_sql_col:
                    mapped_columns[raw_col] = matched_sql_col

            if not mapped_columns:
                print(f"  ❌ 【{fname}】無法對齊資料表 [{table_name}] 任何欄位！")
                continue

            insert_df = df[list(mapped_columns.keys())].rename(columns=mapped_columns).copy()

            if "代號" in insert_df.columns:
                insert_df["代號"] = insert_df["代號"].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True)

            if has_date_col and "日期" not in insert_df.columns:
                insert_df["日期"] = file_date_int

            cur.execute(f"TRUNCATE TABLE {table_name}")

            final_cols = list(insert_df.columns)
            cols_str = ", ".join([f"[{c}]" for c in final_cols])
            placeholders = ", ".join(["?"] * len(final_cols))
            insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO {table_name} ({cols_str}) VALUES ({placeholders})"

            records = []
            for row in insert_df.itertuples(index=False, name=None):
                clean_row = []
                for val in row:
                    if pd.isna(val) or val in ["--", "-", " ", "", "N/A", "null", "NaN"]:
                        clean_row.append(None)
                    elif isinstance(val, (np.integer, int)):
                        clean_row.append(int(val))
                    elif isinstance(val, (np.floating, float)):
                        clean_row.append(float(val))
                    else:
                        clean_row.append(str(val).strip())
                records.append(tuple(clean_row))

            cur.executemany(insert_sql, records)
            conn.commit()

            elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
            print(f"  ✅ 成功灌入【{table_name}】: {len(records)} 筆 (對齊 {len(final_cols)} 欄 | 日期: {file_date_int}) ➔ 來源: {fname}")
            success_cnt += 1
            total_inserted += len(records)

        except Exception as ex:
            print(f"  ❌ 匯入【{table_name}】失敗: {ex}")

    conn.close()
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"🏆 【stockchangedateold1】全欄位精確對齊灌庫完成！")
    print(f"📊 成功灌入: {success_cnt}/15 個資料表 | 總計寫入: {total_inserted} 筆真實資料")
    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import_all()

; =========================================================================
; 🛡️ 工具函式：正常安全關閉 Excel (不觸發未儲存崩潰復原)
; =========================================================================
CloseExcelSafely() {
    try {
        xl := ComObjActive("Excel.Application")
        xl.DisplayAlerts := false
        xl.Quit()
        Sleep, 500
    } catch {
        WinClose, ahk_exe EXCEL.EXE
        Sleep, 500
    }
    if WinExist("ahk_exe EXCEL.EXE") {
        WinKill, ahk_exe EXCEL.EXE
    }
}

CleanExcelAutoRecover() {
    AutoRecoverDir := A_AppData . "\Microsoft\Excel"
    if InStr(FileExist(AutoRecoverDir), "D") {
        FileDelete, %AutoRecoverDir%\*.*
    }
    UnsavedDir := A_LocalAppData . "\Microsoft\Office\UnsavedFiles"
    if InStr(FileExist(UnsavedDir), "D") {
        FileDelete, %UnsavedDir%\*.*
    }
}

    "開盤價": "開盤價",
    "股本(億)": "股本億",
    "市值(億)": "市值億",
    "漲幅%": "漲幅",
    # value (🌟 精準恢復)
    "本益比(預估)": "本益比預估",
    "本益比(近四季)": "本益比近四季",
    "現金殖利率(%)": "現金殖利率",
    "殖利率(%)": "現金殖利率",
    "股價淨值比": "股價淨值比",
    # Mainbrokerage (已驗收成功)
    "賣家>買家(60天)": "買家大於買家60天",
    "買家集中天數(％)": "買家集中天數",
    "買家集中天數(%)": "買家集中天數",
    # Chips
    "15秒看籌碼": "看籌碼15秒",
    "看籌碼15秒": "看籌碼15秒",
}

def get_db():
    return pyodbc.connect(DB_CONN)

def clean_str(s):
    return re.sub(r'[\s\(\)（）%％元億]', '', str(s))

def get_transposed_variants(name):
    s = clean_str(name)
    variants = {s}
    m1 = re.match(r'^(\d+[日秒]?)(.*)$', s)
    if m1 and m1.group(2):
        variants.add(m1.group(2) + m1.group(1))
    m2 = re.match(r'^(.*?)(\d+[日秒]?)$', s)
    if m2 and m2.group(1):
        variants.add(m2.group(2) + m2.group(1))
    return variants

def import_all():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🚀 啟動【理財寶 15 檔 Excel ➔ stockchangedateold1】V1.9 嚴格防串包灌庫特工")
    print(f"📁 讀取目錄: {DATA_DIR}")
    print("=" * 70)

    conn = get_db()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.fast_executemany = False

    success_cnt = 0
    total_inserted = 0

    for prefix, table_name in FILE_TO_TABLE.items():
        # 🌟 核心防禦：採用嚴格前綴匹配 (去掉前方的 *)，絕不讓 value 誤抓 threemastervalue！
        pattern = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"{prefix}*.xlsx")
        matched_files = glob.glob(pattern)

        # 兼容將錯就錯的「卷」
        if not matched_files:
            alt_prefix = prefix.replace("券", "卷") if "券" in prefix else prefix.replace("卷", "券")
            matched_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"{alt_prefix}*.xlsx"))

        if not matched_files:
            print(f"⚠️ 找不到對應 [{prefix}] 的 Excel 檔案，略過。")
            continue

        # 優先取用帶「卷」或修改時間最新的檔案
        juan_files = [f for f in matched_files if "卷" in os.path.basename(f)]
        target_file = juan_files[0] if juan_files else matched_files[0]
        fname = os.path.basename(target_file)
        t0 = time.time()

        try:
            df = pd.read_excel(target_file)
            if df.empty:
                print(f"  ⚠️ 【{fname}】為空檔，略過。")
                continue

            file_mtime = os.path.getmtime(target_file)
            file_date_int = int(datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(file_mtime).strftime("%Y%m%d"))

            cur.execute(f"""
                SELECT c.COLUMN_NAME, 
                       COLUMNPROPERTY(OBJECT_ID(c.TABLE_SCHEMA + '.' + c.TABLE_NAME), c.COLUMN_NAME, 'IsIdentity') AS IsIdentity
                FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c
                WHERE c.TABLE_NAME = '{table_name}'
            """)
            cols_info = cur.fetchall()
            sql_cols_list = [r[0] for r in cols_info if r[1] != 1]
            sql_cols_set = set(sql_cols_list)
            has_date_col = "日期" in sql_cols_set

            mapped_columns = {}
            for raw_col in df.columns:
                raw_str = str(raw_col).strip()
                matched_sql_col = None

                # 1. 霸道鎖定 Mainbrokerage 60天買賣家數
                if table_name == "Mainbrokerage" and "60" in raw_str and ("買" in raw_str or "賣" in raw_str):
                    col_60 = next((c for c in sql_cols_list if "60" in c and "買" in c), None)
                    if col_60:
                        matched_sql_col = col_60

                # 2. 優先比對「精確字典」
                if not matched_sql_col and raw_str in EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING:
                    target_name = EXPLICIT_FIELD_MAPPING[raw_str]
                    if target_name in sql_cols_set:
                        matched_sql_col = target_name

                # 3. 雙向前後倒置
                if not matched_sql_col:
                    excel_variants = get_transposed_variants(raw_str)
                    for sql_col in sql_cols_list:
                        sql_variants = get_transposed_variants(sql_col)
                        if excel_variants.intersection(sql_variants):
                            matched_sql_col = sql_col
                            break

                # 4. 直名完全相同比對
                if not matched_sql_col and raw_str in sql_cols_set:
                    matched_sql_col = raw_str

                if matched_sql_col:
                    mapped_columns[raw_col] = matched_sql_col

            if not mapped_columns:
                print(f"  ❌ 【{fname}】無法對齊資料表 [{table_name}] 任何欄位！")
                continue

            insert_df = df[list(mapped_columns.keys())].rename(columns=mapped_columns).copy()

            if "代號" in insert_df.columns:
                insert_df["代號"] = insert_df["代號"].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True)

            if has_date_col and "日期" not in insert_df.columns:
                insert_df["日期"] = file_date_int

            cur.execute(f"TRUNCATE TABLE {table_name}")

            final_cols = list(insert_df.columns)
            cols_str = ", ".join([f"[{c}]" for c in final_cols])
            placeholders = ", ".join(["?"] * len(final_cols))
            insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO {table_name} ({cols_str}) VALUES ({placeholders})"

            records = []
            for row in insert_df.itertuples(index=False, name=None):
                clean_row = []
                for val in row:
                    if pd.isna(val) or val in ["--", "-", " ", "", "N/A", "null", "NaN"]:
                        clean_row.append(None)
                    elif isinstance(val, (np.integer, int)):
                        clean_row.append(int(val))
                    elif isinstance(val, (np.floating, float)):
                        clean_row.append(float(val))
                    else:
                        clean_row.append(str(val).strip())
                records.append(tuple(clean_row))

            cur.executemany(insert_sql, records)
            conn.commit()

            elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
            print(f"  ✅ 成功灌入【{table_name}】: {len(records)} 筆 (對齊 {len(final_cols)} 欄 | 日期: {file_date_int}) ➔ 來源: {fname}")
            success_cnt += 1
            total_inserted += len(records)

        except Exception as ex:
            print(f"  ❌ 匯入【{table_name}】失敗: {ex}")

    conn.close()
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"🏆 【stockchangedateold1】嚴格防串包灌庫完成！")
    print(f"📊 成功灌入: {success_cnt}/15 個資料表 | 總計寫入: {total_inserted} 筆真實資料")
    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import_all()

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室】雙軌資料庫數據精密對帳特工 V1.0
功能：
  1. 同時連線 stockchangedate (舊人工庫) 與 stockchangedateold1 (新 RPA 庫)
  2. 逐一比對 15 張資料表的「總筆數」、「缺少標的」與「欄位數值」
  3. 自動忽略「自動編號」，並對浮點數進行安全四捨五入比對
================================================================================
"""
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# 🎯 雙軌資料庫連線字串
DB_PROD = r"DRIVER={ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server};SERVER=localhost;DATABASE=stockchangedate;Trusted_Connection=yes;"
DB_TEST = r"DRIVER={ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server};SERVER=localhost;DATABASE=stockchangedateold1;Trusted_Connection=yes;"

TABLES = [
    "basicinfo", "amountchange", "Chips5", "Chips", "finance",
    "Financingbills", "Foreigner", "goodrate", "income", "insiderbiger",
    "investment", "Mainbrokerage", "threemasternumber", "threemastervalue", "value"
]

def get_db(conn_str):
    return pyodbc.connect(conn_str)

def compare_databases():
    print("=" * 75)
    print("⚖️ 【Zen AI 戰情室】雙軌資料庫精密對帳特工啟動")
    print("🟦 基準庫 (人工舊版): stockchangedate")
    print("🟩 測試庫 (RPA 新版): stockchangedateold1")
    print("=" * 75)

    conn_prod = get_db(DB_PROD)
    conn_test = get_db(DB_TEST)

    perfect_match_cnt = 0

    for table in TABLES:
        print(f"\n🔍 正在對帳資料表: 【{table}】...")
        
        try:
            # 讀取兩邊資料
            df_p = pd.read_sql(f"SELECT * FROM [{table}]", conn_prod)
            df_t = pd.read_sql(f"SELECT * FROM [{table}]", conn_test)

            # 1. 比對筆數
            cnt_p, cnt_t = len(df_p), len(df_t)
            if cnt_p == 0 and cnt_t == 0:
                print("  ⚪ 兩邊皆為空表。")
                continue

            print(f"  📊 筆數對比 ➔ 基準庫: {cnt_p} 筆 | 測試庫: {cnt_t} 筆")
            
            # 若無代號欄位則跳過細部比對
            if "代號" not in df_p.columns or "代號" not in df_t.columns:
                print("  ⚠️ 無法鎖定 [代號] 欄位，跳過內容比對。")
                continue

            # 清洗代號作為 Index
            df_p["代號"] = df_p["代號"].astype(str).str.strip()
            df_t["代號"] = df_t["代號"].astype(str).str.strip()
            df_p.set_index("代號", inplace=True)
            df_t.set_index("代號", inplace=True)

            # 剔除不需要比對的干擾欄位 (自動編號, 日期等)
            drop_cols = ["自動編號", "K棒", "日期"]
            for c in drop_cols:
                if c in df_p.columns: df_p.drop(columns=[c], inplace=True)
                if c in df_t.columns: df_t.drop(columns=[c], inplace=True)

            # 2. 比對股票代號缺漏
            missing_in_test = set(df_p.index) - set(df_t.index)
            if missing_in_test:
                print(f"  ❌ 測試庫漏抓了 {len(missing_in_test)} 檔股票 (如: {list(missing_in_test)[:3]})")
            
            # 3. 數值精確比對 (取兩邊都有的股票與欄位)
            common_idx = df_p.index.intersection(df_t.index)
            common_cols = [c for c in df_p.columns if c in df_t.columns]

            df_p_com = df_p.loc[common_idx, common_cols].copy()
            df_t_com = df_t.loc[common_idx, common_cols].copy()

            mismatch_found = False
            for col in common_cols:
                s_p = df_p_com[col].fillna(0)
                s_t = df_t_com[col].fillna(0)

                # 若為數值，四捨五入到小數第 2 位再比，消除浮點數微差
                if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(s_p) and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(s_t):
                    s_p = np.round(pd.to_numeric(s_p, errors='coerce').fillna(0), 2)
                    s_t = np.round(pd.to_numeric(s_t, errors='coerce').fillna(0), 2)
                    
                    # 判斷不相等的布林遮罩
                    diff_mask = ~np.isclose(s_p, s_t, atol=0.01)
                else:
                    # 文字比對
                    s_p = s_p.astype(str).str.strip()
                    s_t = s_t.astype(str).str.strip()
                    diff_mask = (s_p != s_t)

                diff_cnt = diff_mask.sum()
                if diff_cnt > 0:
                    mismatch_found = True
                    sample_idx = df_p_com[diff_mask].index[0]
                    val_p = s_p.loc[sample_idx]
                    val_t = s_t.loc[sample_idx]
                    print(f"  ⚠️ 欄位差異 [{col}]: 共 {diff_cnt} 筆不同 (範例代號 {sample_idx} ➔ 基準值:{val_p} vs 測試值:{val_t})")

            if not missing_in_test and not mismatch_found:
                if cnt_p == cnt_t:
                    print("  ✅ 【完美吻合】兩庫資料筆數與所有欄位數值 100% 相同！")
                    perfect_match_cnt += 1
                else:
                    print("  ⚠️ 內容吻合，但總筆數不同 (測試庫多抓了資料)。")

        except Exception as ex:
            print(f"  ❌ 比對異常: {ex}")

    conn_prod.close()
    conn_test.close()

    print("\n" + "=" * 75)
    print(f"🏆 雙軌對帳報告總結：")
    print(f"🌟 共計 {perfect_match_cnt}/15 個資料表達成 100% 完美吻合！")
    print("=" * 75)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    compare_databases()

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室】雙軌資料庫數據精密對帳特工 V1.1 (最新日期錨定版)
修正重點：
  1. 針對擁有百萬筆歷史資料的基準庫，自動錨定 MAX(日期) 只撈最新一天對帳！
  2. 解決新舊庫資料量不對稱導致的 Pandas Series 對齊報錯
================================================================================
"""
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

DB_PROD = r"DRIVER={ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server};SERVER=localhost;DATABASE=stockchangedate;Trusted_Connection=yes;"
DB_TEST = r"DRIVER={ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server};SERVER=localhost;DATABASE=stockchangedateold1;Trusted_Connection=yes;"

TABLES = [
    "basicinfo", "amountchange", "Chips5", "Chips", "finance",
    "Financingbills", "Foreigner", "goodrate", "income", "insiderbiger",
    "investment", "Mainbrokerage", "threemasternumber", "threemastervalue", "value"
]

def get_db(conn_str):
    return pyodbc.connect(conn_str)

def get_latest_daily_data(conn, table_name, db_label):
    """自動偵測日期欄位，只撈取最新一天的資料進行對帳"""
    cur = conn.cursor()
    try:
        # 尋找最新日期
        cur.execute(f"SELECT MAX(日期) FROM [{table_name}]")
        max_date = cur.fetchone()[0]
        if max_date:
            print(f"    [{db_label}] 鎖定最新日期: {max_date}")
            sql = f"SELECT * FROM [{table_name}] WHERE 日期 = {max_date}"
            return pd.read_sql(sql, conn)
    except Exception:
        pass # 若無日期欄位或報錯，則退回全撈
    
    return pd.read_sql(f"SELECT * FROM [{table_name}]", conn)

def compare_databases():
    print("=" * 75)
    print("⚖️ 【Zen AI 戰情室】雙軌資料庫精密對帳特工啟動 (V1.1 最新日期版)")
    print("🟦 基準庫 (人工舊版): stockchangedate")
    print("🟩 測試庫 (RPA 新版): stockchangedateold1")
    print("=" * 75)

    conn_prod = get_db(DB_PROD)
    conn_test = get_db(DB_TEST)

    perfect_match_cnt = 0

    for table in TABLES:
        print(f"\n🔍 正在對帳資料表: 【{table}】...")
        
        try:
            # 🌟 核心修正：只撈取最新一天的資料
            df_p = get_latest_daily_data(conn_prod, table, "基準庫")
            df_t = get_latest_daily_data(conn_test, table, "測試庫")

            cnt_p, cnt_t = len(df_p), len(df_t)
            if cnt_p == 0 and cnt_t == 0:
                print("  ⚪ 兩邊今日皆無資料。")
                continue

            print(f"  📊 今日筆數對比 ➔ 基準庫: {cnt_p} 筆 | 測試庫: {cnt_t} 筆")
            
            if "代號" not in df_p.columns or "代號" not in df_t.columns:
                print("  ⚠️ 無法鎖定 [代號] 欄位，跳過內容比對。")
                continue

            # 清洗代號為 Index
            df_p["代號"] = df_p["代號"].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True)
            df_t["代號"] = df_t["代號"].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r'\.0$', '', regex=True)
            df_p.set_index("代號", inplace=True)
            df_t.set_index("代號", inplace=True)

            # 剔除不比對的干擾欄位
            drop_cols = ["自動編號", "K棒", "日期"]
            for c in drop_cols:
                if c in df_p.columns: df_p.drop(columns=[c], inplace=True)
                if c in df_t.columns: df_t.drop(columns=[c], inplace=True)

            # 檢查代號漏抓
            missing_in_test = set(df_p.index) - set(df_t.index)
            if missing_in_test:
                print(f"  ❌ 測試庫漏抓了 {len(missing_in_test)} 檔股票 (如: {list(missing_in_test)[:3]})")
            
            # 數值精確比對
            common_idx = df_p.index.intersection(df_t.index)
            common_cols = [c for c in df_p.columns if c in df_t.columns]

            df_p_com = df_p.loc[common_idx, common_cols].copy()
            df_t_com = df_t.loc[common_idx, common_cols].copy()

            mismatch_found = False
            for col in common_cols:
                s_p = df_p_com[col].fillna(0)
                s_t = df_t_com[col].fillna(0)

                if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(s_p) and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(s_t):
                    s_p = np.round(pd.to_numeric(s_p, errors='coerce').fillna(0), 2)
                    s_t = np.round(pd.to_numeric(s_t, errors='coerce').fillna(0), 2)
                    diff_mask = ~np.isclose(s_p, s_t, atol=0.01)
                else:
                    s_p = s_p.astype(str).str.strip()
                    s_t = s_t.astype(str).str.strip()
                    diff_mask = (s_p != s_t)

                diff_cnt = diff_mask.sum()
                if diff_cnt > 0:
                    mismatch_found = True
                    sample_idx = df_p_com[diff_mask].index[0]
                    val_p = s_p.loc[sample_idx]
                    val_t = s_t.loc[sample_idx]
                    print(f"  ⚠️ 欄位差異 [{col}]: 共 {diff_cnt} 筆不同 (範例代號 {sample_idx} ➔ 基準值:{val_p} vs 測試值:{val_t})")

            if not missing_in_test and not mismatch_found:
                if cnt_p == cnt_t:
                    print("  ✅ 【完美吻合】兩庫最新資料筆數與所有欄位數值 100% 相同！")
                    perfect_match_cnt += 1
                else:
                    print("  ⚠️ 內容吻合，但總筆數不同。")

        except Exception as ex:
            print(f"  ❌ 比對異常: {ex}")

    conn_prod.close()
    conn_test.close()

    print("\n" + "=" * 75)
    print(f"🏆 雙軌對帳報告總結：")
    print(f"🌟 共計 {perfect_match_cnt}/15 個資料表達成今日最新數據 100% 完美吻合！")
    print("=" * 75)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    compare_databases()
